Finished Listening to…: My First Summer in the Sierra by John Muir 📚 This was my first John Muir book, and it was a good one. It’s his journal from the summer of 1869, when he spent about four months in California’s Sierra Nevada with a shepherd and a flock of sheep. Watched: Doc Hollywood 🍿 What a great, quaint, feel-good movie. It has been years since I saw it last, but still worth the watch. If you pay attention, there are a few subtle throw backs to Back to the Future in there. #Movies #MichaelJFox
